title: 第13章 这一家人怪可爱的第14章 你还有多少惊喜
slug: 未婚当奶娘可她婴语满级啊
content_zh:
第13章这一家人，怪可爱的！
内堂里灯火通明，烛光摇曳，与这肃清的氛围形成强烈反差。
就着火光，苏念禾匆匆瞥了一眼，就看到了正前方的主座上是个黑脸凶相的老将军——太平侯宋沧渊。
他的脸庞黝黑粗粝，高高的颧骨，带着久经风霜的红晕，纹路沟壑纵横，周身带着肃杀冷冽之气。
许是匆匆回府，他身披铠甲，腰挂宝剑，铁衣在烛光下闪烁着锋芒寒光。
真不愧是久经沙场的老将军，单是挺直腰杆坐在主位上，就如苍松般挺立，哪怕一句话不说，都让人生畏。
而另一个主位上端坐的正是今日见过的老夫人戚峥嵘。
苏念禾赶紧俯身行礼：“拜见侯爷，老夫人，奴婢正是新入府的奶娘。
不知侯爷、老夫人有何吩咐？”
苏念禾言语应答沉稳利落，语气恭敬却不卑微。
行礼后快速起身腰板儿挺直，不曾佝偻半分，自有一身风骨气度。
倒是让老侯爷宋沧渊刮目相看。
他长相粗犷，不苟言笑，往哪里一站，自带冷场气质。
文弱的人见了腿软，闺阁女眷瑟瑟发抖，小娃娃们更是吓哭了不计其数。
更有传言，老将军杀敌用的不是枪与剑，而是那一身煞气。
可这新入府的奶娘小小年纪却能应答自如，不卑不亢，看来夫人的夸赞所言非虚。
他继续黑着脸：“苏奶娘今日可是干了不少好事啊！”
他本意是想夸人，但这语气犹如万年冰霜，反倒有质问的倾向了。
想当初嫡孙刚一出生，他只在门缝里看了一眼就去营帐了。
心里抓肝挠肺的想孙子，无奈公务在身，只得让府兵每隔两个时辰去营帐报一次。

可每次问话，府兵都回小公子在哭。
在哭。
哭。
可把老侯爷给急坏了，他也跟着吃不下睡不着。
后来听说府里张罗这在找奶娘，就盼着能找个能哄住孙儿的。
昨日得到消息，新入府的苏奶娘让小公子止了哭，还喂了奶，可把他高兴坏了。
一连吃了三碗大米饭！
睡觉都能乐出声。
可偏偏到了今日，府兵再也没有快马加鞭去营帐汇报。
直到傍晚也没等到。
什么情况？
老侯爷宋沧渊坐不住了，他安排完军中事物后翻身上马，直接杀了回来。
这不连铠甲都没来得及脱下。
进了府，才知道他的亲孙儿被人下了药，全府上下都在忙活这件事。
府兵也都抽调出来加强安保——看护恶妇了。
那还得了？
老侯爷提着剑，直接去了柴房。
据说，老侯爷一句话都没说，王翠娥、沈春花就吓得屁滚尿流了。
每每回忆起黑夜中，一道寒光劈头盖脸而来，呼啸着斩断她们的头发，就如同见到了活阎王。
她们虽然没死，可是余生皆在恐惧中度过了。

老侯爷虽然生气，但是没有被理智冲昏头脑。
content_en:
Chapter 13 This family is so cute!
The inner hall was brightly lit and the candlelight flickered, forming a strong contrast with the sober atmosphere.
In the light of the fire, Su Nianhe took a quick glance and saw an old general with a dark face and a fierce look sitting on the main seat in front of him - Taiping Marquis Song Cangyuan.
His face was dark and rough, with high cheekbones, a weather-beaten blush, criss-crossed lines, and a chilling air about him.
Xu Shi hurried back home. He was wearing armor and had a sword hanging on his waist. His iron clothes shone with a cold light in the candlelight.
He is indeed a veteran general who has been on the battlefield for a long time. Just sitting straight on the main seat is as upright as a pine tree. Even if he doesn't say a word, he is intimidating.
And sitting on the other main seat was the old lady Qi Zhengrong whom I had seen today.
Su Nianhe quickly leaned over and saluted: "Greetings to the Marquis, madam, this servant is the new nanny who has entered the house.
I wonder what the Marquis and the old lady’s orders are? "
Su Nianhe responded calmly and neatly, with a respectful but not humble tone.
After saluting, he stood up quickly and straightened his back, not even a little bit hunched over, showing his character and dignity.
But it made the old Marquis Song Cangyuan look at him with admiration.
He has a rugged appearance and an unsmiling look. He always has a cool temperament no matter where he stops.
Weak people's legs weakened when they saw it, the ladies in the boudoir shivered, and countless little babies were frightened and cried.
There are even rumors that the old general kills enemies not with guns and swords, but with his evil spirit.
But this new nanny at such a young age was able to respond with ease and was neither humble nor overbearing. It seemed that the lady's praise was true.
He continued with a dark face: "Nanny Su has done a lot of good things today!"
His original intention was to praise, but his tone was like ice, and instead he had a tendency to question.
I remember that when his grandson was born, he only glanced through the crack in the door and went to camp.
My heart was scratching my head and I missed my grandson, but I had no choice but to attend to official duties, so I had to ask the soldiers to report to the camp every two hours.
But every time I asked, the soldiers replied that the young master was crying.
Crying.
cry.
But the old Marquis was so anxious that he couldn't eat or sleep.
Later, I heard that Zhang Luo in the mansion was looking for a nanny, so I was looking forward to finding one who could coax the grandchild.
I got the news yesterday that the new wet nurse Su made the young master stop crying and fed him milk, which made him extremely happy.
I ate three bowls of rice in a row!
I can make noises while sleeping.
But today, the soldiers no longer rushed to the camp to report.
Didn't wait until evening.
What's going on?
Old Marquis Song Cangyuan couldn't sit still. After arranging military matters, he got on his horse and came back directly to fight.
He didn't even have time to take off his armor.
After entering the mansion, he found out that his grandson had been drugged, and the whole mansion was busy working on it.
The government soldiers have also been deployed to strengthen security - to look after the evil woman.
Is that okay?
The old marquis took his sword and went directly to the woodshed.
It is said that Wang Cui'e and Shen Chunhua were scared to death without even saying a word.
Every time I recall that in the dark night, a cold light came over their heads and cut off their hair, it was like seeing the living king of hell.
Although they did not die, they spent the rest of their lives in fear.
Although the old Marquis was angry, he was not carried away by reason.
